title: Retrieval recall returned 1.0 when the benchmark declares no gold evidence
evidence: Function returned 1.0 for empty gold_spans. This is the exact failure that correction #5 claims was fixed; the fix was applied only to experiments.retrieval_metrics (returns NaN) and never to this second live copy.
fix: Return float('nan') when there is no gold-evidence denominator; macro_average now excludes NaN from both numerator and denominator instead of propagating it.
residual_risk: Only benchmark.py consumed this path, so no published number changes. Any historical aggregate produced by benchmark.py that mixed answerable and unanswerable questions was inflated.

title: Process peak working set silently recorded as null on 64-bit Windows
evidence: ctypes left the default 32-bit int restype on GetCurrentProcess, truncating the (HANDLE)-1 pseudo-handle. GetProcessMemoryInfo returned 0 with ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE (6), the guard returned None, and the field was written as null. Reproduced directly: default restype -> -1 -> failure; corrected restype -> 18446744073709551615 -> 18.1 MB.
fix: Declare argtypes/restype (HANDLE, POINTER(Counters), DWORD -> BOOL) on explicitly loaded kernel32/psapi handles.
verification: tests/test_defect_regressions.py::ProcessMemoryMeasurementTests and tests/test_experiment_contracts.py asserts the field is non-null and > 0
residual_risk: Correction #16's claim that OS-reported peak working set 'is now recorded' was false as shipped. The value covers the whole evaluator process and is still not attributable to one method.

title: Traditional baseline reported final_k as candidates examined
evidence: The baseline trace emitted only retrieved_k, so method_metrics fell back to result.final_k. Whenever the shared 2000-token budget truncated the static top-k, the baseline's retrieval work was understated (pilot: 8 reported instead of 20 examined).
fix: Baseline run_completed trace now emits candidates_examined, retrieval_rounds, retrieved_before_deduplication and final_context_tokens so both arms populate the same schema.
residual_risk: retrieval_rounds for the baseline changes from an implicit 0 to an explicit 1. This is a metric-definition change and is disclosed rather than silently applied.

title: Calibration retained every sampled corpus for the whole search
evidence: corpus_cache and the corpora list held both index families for all sampled examples simultaneously; peak memory grew with sample size. Correction #11 applied this bound to experiments.py only.
fix: Restructured to examples-outermost / configurations-innermost with a single active corpus, matching experiments.py's one-active-corpus policy. corpus_cache_policy and corpora_built are now recorded in the manifest.
verification: Version-2 calibration reproduction compared field-by-field against version 1 (VERSION1_VS_VERSION2_CALIBRATION.json)
residual_risk: Each (example, configuration) evaluation is independent given the corpus, so results are unchanged; a corpus repeated non-adjacently is rebuilt (58 unique corpora for 60 examples, so ~2 rebuilds).

title: Empty analysis tables were silently not written
evidence: _write_csv returned early on empty rows, so table_failures.csv and manual_failure_review_sample.csv were never created and their absence was indistinguishable from 'not requested'. Root cause of the missing artifacts named in the brief.
fix: Always emit the file; write an explicit header when the schema is known and a visible no_rows_produced marker otherwise.
verification: Regenerated analysis produces both files; header-only output is visibly empty rather than absent
residual_risk: The underlying reason those tables were empty is that the stale pilot lacks gold_evidence_spans, provisional_evidence and representation_gold_diagnostic. Populated failure tables require a run by the current code.

title: Figure writing selected an interactive matplotlib backend
evidence: pyplot was imported without forcing a backend. A broken Tk installation raised _tkinter.TclError and aborted the process. In a confirmatory run this happens after every paid API call has been made.
fix: matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True) before importing pyplot in both figure paths.
verification: Full suite passes deterministically across repeated runs (73 tests)
residual_risk: results.json and paired_metrics.csv are written before save_graphs, so results were never lost; the run exited non-zero and produced no figure.

title: Research tests could not run in the project virtual environment
evidence: pytest was absent from .venv; the documented command invoked C:\\ProgramData\\anaconda3\\python.exe, which carries scipy, pandas, torchvision and pytest 7.4.4 that .venv does not have. Tests therefore never validated the environment that runs the research.
fix: pytest installed into .venv (9.1.1). Entire suite now runs against the same interpreter and dependency set as the research code.
residual_risk: pytest is not declared in pyproject.toml; a fresh checkout still will not have it. Recommend adding a [project.optional-dependencies] test extra.

title: RRF threshold is described as a normalized-RRF quantity but is a fraction of total probe mass
evidence: The protocol defines NRRF(g) = RRF(g)/(n_representations/(c+1)). The selector computes that, then divides each representation's NRRF mass by the summed NRRF mass of all aligned probe groups. The frozen 0.2437 is therefore a share of total aligned probe mass, not a raw NRRF value.
fix: No code change. Behaviour is identical between calibration and inference, so the frozen threshold remains valid under its true definition. The paper formula must be corrected.
residual_risk: Publishing the current formula would misstate the method. Correcting the text is mandatory before submission.

title: Calibration selection rule applies an undocumented second recall filter
evidence: Documented rule: shortlist on tuning recall within 0.01, then maximize complete-evidence on the held-back partition. Implemented rule additionally re-filters to selection-partition recall within 0.01 of the best before applying the lexicographic order.
fix: Not silently changed. Both rules are stated in AUDIT_REPORT.md with a version-2 recommendation.
verification: Version 1 and version 2 manifests are byte-identical in every trial and selected value
residual_risk: The implemented rule is strictly more recall-protective than the documented one, so it did not bias toward the efficiency-favouring configuration. The written rule is still wrong.

title: Partition described as 70/30 is 60/40
evidence: round(5 * 0.30) = 2 under banker's rounding, so each 5-example stratum yields 3 tuning and 2 selection. Realized split is 36 tuning / 24 selection.
fix: Documentation corrected to 60/40 for version 1. A clean 70/30 needs a preregistered per-stratum size (e.g. 10 per stratum -> 7/3).
residual_risk: 'selection': 24})
column11: No effect on validity; the held-back partition is larger than advertised, which is conservative.

title: Representation tie-break uses probe words, not probe tokens
evidence: The protocol says ties resolve by lower probe-token cost; the implementation averages word_count.
fix: No code change during an audit. Either correct the text or switch to tokenizer tokens in version 2.
column11: Affects only exact ties in normalized coverage, which are rare; low impact.

title: Pause patience documented as two batches, frozen at three
evidence: Prose describes the dataclass default (2) rather than the calibrated frozen value (3).
fix: Documentation must quote the frozen manifest, not the executable defaults.
residual_risk: Config defaults intentionally differ from frozen values; this is safe only because experiments.py refuses to run confirmatory mode without a manifest.

title: Representation granularity partially confounds the context-token claim (severity REVISED DOWN after measurement)
evidence: AUDITOR CORRECTION: the initial HIGH severity was inferred from configuration parameters (256 vs 95 words = 2.7x) without measuring realized output. Measured on a 36-example training sample the realized ratio is 1.73x on QASPER (109.5 vs 63.3 mean words) and 1.44x on MuSiQue (79.0 vs 54.9). The confound is real but roughly half the size the parameters imply, because sliding windows terminate early at parent-section boundaries.
fix: Added sliding_window_matched (95-word target, realized 64-70 words) plus fixed-k sensitivity at 3/5/10/20 and a token-budget-matched comparison in tools/retrieval_only_screening.py.
verification: RETRIEVAL_ONLY_ABLATIONS.csv. Decisive result: at matched context (SAR 1313 tokens vs sliding_window_k10 1293 tokens) SAR-RAG achieves recall 0.7054 vs 0.6492 and complete-evidence 0.5814 vs 0.4651, so the matched-budget advantage is NOT explained by granularity.
residual_risk: Granularity must still be disclosed, but it does not overturn the matched-budget comparison. The correct framing is budget-matched, not k-matched.

title: Complete-evidence recovery is scored on questions declared unanswerable
evidence: is_supporting paragraphs are collected regardless of answerability, so 1876 of 2417 MuSiQue INSUFFICIENT examples carry gold evidence spans and are scored for recall and complete-evidence recovery. QASPER INSUFFICIENT examples have none and correctly score NaN.
fix: No code change. Version-2 options: (i) report retrieval metrics on ANSWERABLE only, (ii) report answerable and insufficient strata separately, or (iii) justify scoring residual supporting paragraphs on unanswerable items.
verification: Counts reproduced directly from the normalized evaluation files
residual_risk: 39% of the MuSiQue evaluation set is affected. Pooling these with answerable items makes complete-evidence recovery hard to interpret.

title: Primary outcomes have very different valid paired n
evidence: Answer metrics are NaN without gold answers and retrieval metrics NaN without gold spans. Valid paired n: answer_token_f1 3789; evidence_set_recall and complete_evidence_recovery 5645; context_tokens 6285 (of 6285 questions).
fix: No code change. Holm correction across four outcomes with different n is legitimate but must be reported per outcome.
verification: Counted from the normalized evaluation files
residual_risk: Reporting a single 'n = 6285' beside all four primary outcomes would be misleading.

title: Second representation is selected in a small minority of queries
evidence: At the frozen 0.2437 threshold the mean selected-representation count is 1.125, implying roughly 12.5% two-view selection on the held-back calibration partition.
fix: tools/retrieval_only_screening.py now reports one- vs two-view frequency, per-state counts, second-view unique gold contribution, and the share of queries where an unselected view holds unique gold evidence.
residual_risk: If this holds out, the 'one or two complementary representations' contribution is carried by a small minority of queries and must not be claimed as a general mechanism.

title: Chunk-level rank metrics are not comparable across arms
evidence: precision_at_k divides by the cutoff rather than by the number retrieved, so an arm with smaller emergent final_k is penalized at large k. The two arms also use different chunk granularities.
fix: No code change; the module already carries a rank_metrics caveat naming gold-span recall and complete-evidence recovery as the primary retrieval outcomes.
residual_risk: P@k, MRR and nDCG must stay secondary and be read with the granularity caveat.

title: One invalid claim downgrades an entire answer to INSUFFICIENT
evidence: If any single claim has empty text or an out-of-range evidence id, invalid is set and the whole response is replaced by INSUFFICIENT, even when other claims were well formed.
fix: No code change; this is the declared safe-downgrade policy and it is applied identically to both arms.
verification: Inspection; the shared generator makes the policy symmetric
residual_risk: Symmetric across arms, but an arm that emits more claims has more chances to trip it. Worth measuring as an answerability confound.

title: Confirmatory figure captioned as a pilot
evidence: The quality panel title is hard-coded 'Quality (descriptive pilot)' regardless of run status.
fix: Not changed during the audit to avoid touching output unrelated to a correctness contract. Should be driven by summary['status'] in version 2.
residual_risk: A confirmatory figure would carry a pilot caption; misleading if reproduced in a paper.

title: Embedding revision pin is inert on the local snapshot path
evidence: revision= is passed to from_pretrained, but Hugging Face ignores it when loading from a local directory. experiments.py additionally constructs the encoder with a relative path and no revision argument at all.
fix: No code change. Provenance is in fact established by the recorded weight sha256, which was verified to match.
residual_risk: The revision guarantee rests on the sha256 check, not on the revision= argument. experiments.py depends on the working directory being the repository root.

title: A single-view baseline outperforms the full routed system on retrieval-only screening
evidence: On a fresh 60-example training sample (seed distinct from calibration), paragraph_only beats full on every retrieval outcome: recall 0.8004 vs 0.7054, complete-evidence 0.6512 vs 0.5814, precision 0.1751 vs 0.1595, context tokens 1281 vs 1313, candidates examined 22.9 vs 33.4.
fix: No code change. This is an empirical finding about the method, not a bug. It must be reported and cannot be omitted.
residual_risk: Directly undermines the central contribution. Always selecting the paragraph view is simpler, cheaper and better on this training sample. The routing mechanism must be justified against this null, not only against all_representations_no_rrf.

title: The novelty and similarity-gap components have no measurable effect
evidence: no_novelty and no_similarity_gap reproduce the full condition to four decimal places on every metric (recall 0.7054, complete-evidence 0.5814, precision 0.1595, context tokens 1312.7, final_k 15.15, candidates 33.4). At the frozen thresholds (novelty 0.2292, standardized gap 1.9052) neither rule ever binds on this sample.
fix: No code change. Report as a negative ablation result.
residual_risk: Two named mechanisms in the paper are inert as calibrated. They must not be claimed as contributing components without end-to-end evidence that contradicts this.

title: The RRF constant is nearly irrelevant
evidence: rrf_k0 in {1,3,10,60} moves recall only between 0.7054 and 0.7171 and leaves complete-evidence unchanged at 0.5814. The config comment asserting that k0=60 makes ranks 1-3 almost equal and is therefore unsuitable is not supported.
fix: No code change. Report the sensitivity sweep as evidence that the method is insensitive to this frozen constant.
residual_risk: Insensitivity is a robustness point, not a contribution. Do not present c=3 as a tuned advantage.

title: The second representation contributes almost nothing
evidence: Two views are selected for 16.7% of queries (10/60), and concentrate in QASPER (9/30) versus MuSiQue (1/30). The second view adds unique probe gold evidence in only 20% of those cases (2 of 10), i.e. 3.3% of all queries. select_one_representation loses only 0.0116 recall and zero complete-evidence relative to full.
fix: No code change. Confirms and quantifies D16 on a fresh training sample.
residual_risk: The 'one or two complementary representations' framing is not supported as a general mechanism and is essentially a QASPER-only effect.

title: Probe depth 3 is not the best probe depth on training data
evidence: probe_depth_5 improves recall to 0.7519 (+0.047) and complete-evidence to 0.6279 (+0.047) over the frozen probe depth of 3, at a cost of 39.0 versus 33.4 candidates examined.
fix: No change. Probe depth is frozen; altering it now would be tuning after the fact. Report as a registered sensitivity result and consider preregistering probe depth 5 for a version-2 calibration.
residual_risk: Do not silently adopt probe depth 5. It must go through a fresh training-only calibration if adopted.

title: Thirty percent of queries terminate at the final-chunk safety cap
evidence: Stop reasons on the full condition: all_selected_representations_paused 38/60, final_chunk_safety_cap 18/60 (30.0%), retrieval_round_safety_cap 4/60 (6.7%). Mean final_k is 15.15 against a cap of 20.
fix: No code change. Required disclosure under the audit rule that a system mostly hitting its caps behaves like a capped retriever rather than an adaptive one.
residual_risk: A majority still stops adaptively, so the system is not purely capped, but 36.7% terminating on a safety cap materially weakens the 'no fixed k' framing and must be reported.
